summary.en: Search and read files in Box

description.zh: 在 Box 中搜索文件和文件夹、读取文档内容与元数据。适合从企业网盘里找资料并直接引用。首次连接在浏览器登录 Box 授权。
description.en: Search files and folders in Box and read document content and metadata. Useful for pulling reference material out of a company drive. Sign in to Box in the browser on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 Box 并授权
authHint.en: Sign in to Box and authorize on first connect
